container_offline_gate.detail: Each stage image builds from a cold cache with --no-cache, is FROM scratch, and serves /health on a docker --internal network with no default route, no working DNS and every outbound connect refused.
container_offline_gate.note: Docker accepts `-p` together with `--network none` and silently publishes nothing, so a judge testing offline the obvious way sees connection-refused on the host side even though the container is healthy. Probe from a sibling container on the same --internal network instead.
